requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/chunk.js` and your own tests in `tests/chunk.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `chunk(array, size)` splitting an array into consecutive chunks of at most `size` (last may be shorter). size < 1 or non-integer throws RangeError. Does not mutate the input.
